title: Regulated Medical Device & Clinical AI Software Governance (ISO 13485 / EU MDR)

pages.content: Directive MED-MDR-704 governs AI-assisted workflows in healthcare and medical imaging environments under EU MDR and ISO 13485. Generative and retrieval systems are strictly classified as clinical documentation and evidence-lookup aids; they must never issue autonomous diagnostic conclusions or treatment orders. Licensed clinician sign-off is mandatory for all Class IIa and Class IIb workflows.

In accordance with traceability control ISO-13485-CL-7.5.8, every synthesized clinical protocol answer must display the exact source document ID, page number, effective date, and SHA-256 content digest. If an underlying clinical SOP is updated, all previously approved summaries referencing the superseded digest are automatically invalidated.

Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) audits must be executed every 90 days on clinical retrieval pipelines. Synthesized responses must achieve a minimum NLI passage entailment score of 0.78 on every atomic sentence, and any response citing a guideline within 15 days of staleness expiration must display an explicit clinical governance warning.
